findOrders:
Retrieve a single **Sales Order header** from JobBOSS².

• Path parameter: `orderNumber` (string).
• Optional query param `fields` lets you reduce the payload. Use a comma-separated list of column names such as `dueDate,customerCode,status`. If omitted, defaults to those three fields.
• Returns **exactly one** Order-header record or 404 if the order does not exist.
• Typical follow-up tools: `getOrderLines`, `allocateInventoryToOrder`.
getOrderLines:
Return an array of **Order Line Items** for the given `orderNumber`.

• Query param `orderNumber` performs equality match (`…/order-line-items?orderNumber=114897`).
• Uses `fields=orderNumber,line,partNumber,quantityOrdered` to keep the payload small.
• The response shape is `{ items:[ { orderNumber, line, partNumber, quantityOrdered } ] }` or `{ Data:[ … ] }` depending on tenant version.
• Typical chaining: pipe each `partNumber` into `getOnHandQty` or `getBinLocations`.
getBinLocations:
List **every bin** that currently holds the specified `partNumber`.

• Query: `…/bin-locations?fields=partNumber,bin,quantityOnHand&partNumber=ABC123`.
• Returns one row per bin with current on-hand quantity.
• If the part is not in stock, items / Data will be an empty array.
• Use this for pick-list generation or stock investigations.
getOnHandQty:
Return the **total on-hand quantity** for a given `partNumber`, aggregated across all bins.

• Query: `…/bin-locations?fields=quantityOnHand&partNumber=ABC123`.
• The helper sums the `quantityOnHand` column of every returned row and returns `{ quantityOnHand: <number> }`.
• This avoids an extra aggregate call and keeps the endpoint simple.
createPurchaseOrder:
Create a new **Purchase Order header**.

Inputs:
• `supplier` – vendor code (string).
• `requiredDate` – ISO date the vendor should ship by.

Returns the PO header JSON including `poNumber`, which you will need for `addPOLine`.
addPOLine:
Append a **line item** to an existing PO.

Inputs:
• `poNumber` – target PO.
• `partNumber` – what to buy.
• `quantity` – integer.
• `dueDate` – ISO date promised/required.

No meaningful response body; treat success as HTTP 200/201.
finalizePO:
Set a Purchase Order’s status (default **Approved**) and optionally update `promisedDate`.

After calling this tool the PO is considered ready to send to the vendor.
checkOrderOnHandQty:
Produce a side-by-side **availability snapshot** for every line of `orderNumber`.

Output shape:
```
{
  orderNumber: "114897",
  lines: [
    {
      line: 10,
      partNumber: "ABC123",
      qtyOrdered: 4,
      qtyOnHand: 2,
      shortage: 2
    },
    …
  ]
}
```
Typical follow-up: if any `shortage > 0`, call `issuePOsForShortages`.
